title: PROFINET: dcerpc-pn-io various spelling and encoding fixes

notes.body:
@NilsNCodewerk - could you please check this change?  Hopefully the spellings (even if not from you!) are ok to make.

I think some of the encoding changes are really because an FT_UINT type item is added for the subtree root items, but I added them with ENC_BIG_ENDIAN anyway, and in 1 or 2 cases changed the width of the field or width in the call.

Sorry for the late response. Most of the changes look good to me, but why did you change the supportedBurstSize from FT_UINT16 to FT_UINT64? According to the standard, this field should be defined as FT_UINT32.

Ah, I misread how many bytes came under that heading (I thought it was 2 separate 32-bit fields, rather than 2 fields within the same 32 bits). please check https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/20269/
